extension.summary: Fixes stale leftover system addon copies (e.g. xbmc.python) that silently block other addon installs
extension.description: On long-lived CoreELEC installs that have been through several major Kodi version upgrades, a handful of genuinely system/bundled addons (shipped in /usr/share/kodi/addons, which gets fully replaced on every OS update) can end up with an old leftover local copy in /storage/.kodi/addons (which deliberately survives every OS update untouched, by design, to protect user settings/addons) that Kodi keeps using instead of the current one shipped with the installed Kodi binary. This silently blocks installing any addon that requires a newer version of that dependency - most commonly xbmc.python itself - with no clear error shown anywhere. At every Kodi startup, this service compares each addon id that genuinely exists in /usr/share/kodi/addons against any local /storage/.kodi/addons copy of the same id; if the local one is older, it removes it so Kodi re-registers the current bundled version from /usr/share on the next restart. It only ever touches ids that are real bundled system addons (a short, stable list - about 45 on a typical CoreELEC box) and only when the local copy is strictly older, never a normal repo-installed addon and never a local copy that's equal or newer. A Kodi restart is needed after a fix is applied; a one-time notification says so, and the fix is confirmed (and the notification won't repeat) once the stale copy is actually gone after that restart.
extension.news: 1.0.0: initial release. Root-caused on box "oco" (2026-10-19): xbmc.python was stuck at 2.26.0 in /storage/.kodi/addons since a 2019/2021-era install, despite the box running Kodi 20.5-Nexus (system copy 3.0.1) - this silently blocked installing script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed (requires xbmc.python >= 3.0.0) with no error anywhere in the GUI or log. Declares only a low xbmc.python requirement (2.1.0) itself on purpose, so it can actually be installed on a box affected by the exact problem it exists to fix.
